fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that the complainant lost a gold chain of about 6 sovereigns to a person who grabbed it near Kadal Nagar Bus Stand Area in Coimbatore and ran. The matter was brought to Coimbatore South PS on 2026-02-14, while the incident was placed on 2026-02-14 around 14:40 hrs. The complaint was lodged by Malathi Murugan (9000000027). No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. The complaint mentions Madhan Murugan, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000216, in connection with the events. A further person, Karthik Rajan, a business acquaintance, using the number 9000000091, is stated to be associated with the incident. The complainant mentioned CCTV footage and photographs. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00339, as the mobile number 9000000216 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Chain allegedly snatched from behind while the victim was walking.
fields.Keywords: chain snatching, gold chain, mobile number, photograph, afternoon, associate, suspect, CCTV
